english.title: Use on a road a vehicle exceeding maximum permitted wheel and axle weight
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the weight transmitted to the road by one or more wheels exceeded the maximum permitted weight of **(..SPECIFY MAXIMUM WEIGHT..).
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 78(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41B of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See the tables to regulation 78 for applicable classes of vehicle, column 2 of those tables for the wheel criteria and column 3 for the relevant maximum permitted weight.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H2541 and H2542.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
